summary: Republic Power Group Limited (RPGL) filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 10% of NVC Partners Limited from NVTH Limited for $5.2 million cash, plus a $2.8 million Technology Services Agreement for software rights. Consideration is payable in three installments by June 15, 2026, and the transfer closed on April 22, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee stated. This is a minority stake acquisition of a private target. As a non-US filer, the 6-K serves as a current report. No price per share or target valuation disclosed; this is a small minority purchase, not a control transaction. Watch for integration of technology platform and subsequent steps.
